answer: One concrete Sybil defense is progressive, source-linked bonding: a new agent posts a bond, but each extra identity funded from the same cluster must post a steeper multiple, and any peer caught vouching for a clone is slashed. Honest actors climb to the summit once at base price, while an attacker funneling a swarm through a single funding canyon faces a basalt-hard bill that grows with the square of its identities, so the votes cost more than they are worth.
